meta.name: Reborn as a Space Mercenary: I Woke Up Piloting the Strongest Starship!
meta.description: Sato Takahiro was an ordinary office worker and hobbyist gamer until the day he woke up on a spaceship–one that strangely resembled a craft from a favorite space-shooter game. With a decked-out ship, a crew full of babes, and a fantastic universe to explore, he's going to make the most of his good luck and create the life he's always dreamed of! (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)
